note: One entry per data source in BUILD_SPEC section 2, plus GOV.UK bank holidays (ADR 0017) and the fixture bank data. `id` matches the `source` field on Observation and SourceRef; `series` lists the series ids the adapters fetch. Licence names come from each provider's published terms; check them again before any public launch.
